scope: Static plan and source inventory only; no case status inferred from historical tests.

cases.title: Strict V5 parse boundary
cases.nativePlan: Representative native readonly codec probe: malformed/future/unknown/oversized/invalid relationships; source unchanged.
cases.originalPlan: Representative native readonly codec probe: malformed/future/unknown/oversized/invalid relationships; source unchanged.

cases.title: All frozen V1-V4 migrations
cases.nativePlan: Native representative V4 migration; exact legacy projections for all12 remain source-level coverage.
cases.originalPlan: Native representative V4 migration; exact legacy projections for all12 remain source-level coverage.

cases.title: First V5 write atomic backup
cases.nativePlan: Before/after eight known checkpoint keys; original V4 envelope and existing historical backup exact.
cases.originalPlan: Before/after eight known checkpoint keys; original V4 envelope and existing historical backup exact.

cases.title: Quota before first V5 write
cases.nativePlan: Synthetic target-primary quota error in actual native transaction; complete raw rows unchanged; retry succeeds once.
cases.originalPlan: Synthetic target-primary quota error in actual native transaction; complete raw rows unchanged; retry succeeds once.

cases.title: Actual transaction abort
cases.nativePlan: Call actual target transaction.abort; no escaped second-abort error; all rows unchanged.
cases.originalPlan: Call actual target transaction.abort; no escaped second-abort error; all rows unchanged.

cases.title: Two independent V5 tab owners
cases.nativePlan: Prepare same revision/generation, race real candidates, exactly one winner; loser memory unchanged/conflict.
cases.originalPlan: Prepare same revision/generation, race real candidates, exactly one winner; loser memory unchanged/conflict.

cases.title: Held and stale V4 binary barrier
cases.nativePlan: Owned held connection blocks then releases; current old V4 client cannot reopen/write over version5.
cases.originalPlan: Owned held connection blocks then releases; current old V4 client cannot reopen/write over version5.

cases.title: Post-migration quota/abort and retry
cases.nativePlan: Original command candidate fails atomically then explicit retry/cold; no optimistic cash/stock/reward.
cases.originalPlan: Original command candidate fails atomically then explicit retry/cold; no optimistic cash/stock/reward.

cases.title: Corrupt primary with valid previous
cases.nativePlan: Read refuses; review/cancel do not write; explicit restore preserves corrupt original and exact archival backups.
cases.originalPlan: Read refuses; review/cancel do not write; explicit restore preserves corrupt original and exact archival backups.

cases.title: Future schema/envelope and unknown content
cases.nativePlan: Future schema/envelope blocked even with valid previous. Unknown-content refusal follows actual codec/recovery policy; no silent normalization.
cases.originalPlan: Future schema/envelope blocked even with valid previous. Unknown-content refusal follows actual codec/recovery policy; no silent normalization.

cases.title: Missing or corrupt migration provenance
cases.nativePlan: Separate disposable branches for V4/V3 backup missing/corrupt; read/write/reset/recovery blocked without reconstruction.
cases.originalPlan: Separate disposable branches for V4/V3 backup missing/corrupt; read/write/reset/recovery blocked without reconstruction.

cases.title: Stale reviewed recovery quote
cases.nativePlan: Second native tab changes the source; first quote cannot overwrite primary/previous/backups.
cases.originalPlan: Second native tab changes the source; first quote cannot overwrite primary/previous/backups.

cases.title: Generation/reset ABA and single-use Undo
cases.nativePlan: Fresh disposable branch only: reset reaches revision1/new generation; stale writer rejected; Undo once/cold retains V5 and exact V4 archive.
cases.originalPlan: Fresh disposable branch only: reset reaches revision1/new generation; stale writer rejected; Undo once/cold retains V5 and exact V4 archive.

cases.title: Pending autosave drain and closing candidate
cases.nativePlan: Original autosave serializes candidate and final checkpoint; saved/clean drain required before cold equality.
cases.originalPlan: Original autosave serializes candidate and final checkpoint; saved/clean drain required before cold equality.

cases.title: Actual Zebra mission award race/replay
cases.nativePlan: Actual source-earned ZQ02 cash candidate150ZC; ZQ01 is a zero-coin award. Exactly one real two-tab CAS winner plus unchanged losing memory, cold and ticket checks.
cases.originalPlan: Real source ZQ01 candidate/expected command; one durable reward, no losing-tab adoption, quota/retry/cold exact.

cases.title: Legacy grants and Zebra grant dependency
cases.nativePlan: Legacy grant/reward objects unchanged. No Zebra grant command exists; synthetic claimed-grant fixture does not close Z2-06 or prove1700ZC once-only.
cases.nativeEvidence: Current strict fixture/legacy grant objects preserved; no new Zebra grant command
cases.originalPlan: Legacy grant/reward objects unchanged. No Zebra grant command exists; synthetic claimed-grant fixture does not close Z2-06 or prove1700ZC once-only.

cases.title: One paid ticket per real admission
cases.nativePlan: Source-caused paid admission, cold duplicate check and compacted receipt history; no duplicate revenue, identities or reward viewer credit.
cases.originalPlan: Source-caused paid admission, cold duplicate check and compacted receipt history; no duplicate revenue, identities or reward viewer credit.

cases.title: Final isolation, diagnostics and closure
sourceCoverage: all selected source files plus native receipts
cases.nativePlan: Only fresh fault UUIDs; named lineage reads before write; no owner/default/carried/profile clearing; zero owned processes/owners/pending writes after close.
cases.originalPlan: Only fresh fault UUIDs; named lineage reads before write; no owner/default/carried/profile clearing; zero owned processes/owners/pending writes after close.
